An entry counts ONLY when evidence, attested_by and attested_on are all non-empty.
An empty entry is a FAIL: the brief is explicit that no evidence is never a pass.
Entries marked UNSPECIFIED_BY_REQUIREMENT cannot be attested at all: the source
document fixes no value to verify against. They stay FAIL and are reported as
specification gaps, not as implementation defects.

REQ-008-T01.what_must_be_attested: The engagement ran for the stated duration.
REQ-008-T01.what_would_count_as_evidence: The actual elapsed engagement time against the stated 20 hours. A commit-history window, a timesheet, or a dated statement of when work started and stopped.
REQ-008-T01.where_to_look: git log --reverse --date=iso --format='%ad %s' | head -1, and the last commit's date.

REQ-009-T01.what_must_be_attested: The delivery team matched the stated team size.
REQ-009-T01.what_would_count_as_evidence: The number of people on the delivery team, and whether that is within 2-4. State it plainly; if the team was one person, say so - a failed attestation that is true is worth more than a passed one that is not.

REQ-010-T02.what_must_be_attested: The review was performed automatically against the Hackathon Rubric with no live demo judging.
REQ-010-T02.source_text: Evaluation Mode | Automated review of the submitted Git repository against the Hackathon Rubric (7 categories / 100 marks), scored entirely from committed evidence in the repository. No live demo judging.
REQ-010-T02.what_would_count_as_evidence: Confirmation that the review was run this way - automated, from committed evidence, with no live demo judged. Only the reviewer or the submitter can say how the review was actually conducted.
REQ-010-T02.where_to_look: The reviewer's instructions or the returned scorecard.

REQ-011-T03.what_must_be_attested: The push happened by the cut-off.
REQ-011-T03.why_it_cannot_be_signed: The source document fixes no value or artifact to verify against. The validator records this as a specification gap rather than an implementation defect, and the check is written never to pass.

REQ-012-T01.what_must_be_attested: The per-team Excel review report with its five stated sections was produced.
REQ-012-T01.source_text: Review Output | Per-team Excel report (Summary, Categories, Scorecard, Detailed, Improvement).
REQ-012-T01.what_would_count_as_evidence: That the per-team Excel report was produced with those five sheets. Cite the file - name, date received, and that the five sections are present.
REQ-012-T01.where_to_look: The review report itself, if it has been returned.

REQ-013-T01.what_must_be_attested: The stated grade bands were applied.
REQ-013-T01.source_text: Grade Bands | Pass >= 60 - Not Yet Passed < 60
REQ-013-T01.what_would_count_as_evidence: That the stated bands were the ones applied - a score at or above 60 recorded as Pass, below 60 as Not Yet Passed. Cite the returned grade.

_how_to_sign: TO SIGN AN ENTRY, fill in all three of:
evidence      - what you are relying on, concretely. Not 'yes'.
attested_on   - the date, ISO format, e.g. 2026-09-22.
An entry counts ONLY when all three are non-empty. Leaving one blank is a
FAIL, which is the correct outcome for something nobody has checked.
Attest only to what you know. A truthful FAIL is worth more than a passed
check that says something you cannot stand behind - the whole point of the
The entries marked unspecified_by_requirement cannot be signed at all: the
